groups.operation: Compile the fuzz entry that includes ares.h.
groups.condition: The public header is under include/, while the compile command searches only -I.
groups.capability: Resolve include/ares.h when compiling the entry.
groups.consequence: The entry cannot compile because ares.h is not found through the supplied search path.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same header search path mismatch for the same entry compile operation.

groups.operation: Link the fuzz target with libcares.a.
groups.condition: The library target is under src/lib/, while the link command names the former root .libs/libcares.a.
groups.capability: Locate and link the archive produced by the src/lib libcares.la target.
groups.consequence: The target cannot link using the supplied archive path.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same archive location mismatch for the same link operation.

groups.operation: Parse a valid PTR reply and produce a host result carrying the caller-supplied address.
groups.condition: The PTR call fixes the address to four IPv4 bytes and the family to AF_INET.
groups.capability: Supply a 16-byte IPv6 address, its length, and AF_INET6 to the PTR parser.
groups.consequence: The call cannot exercise a PTR host result carrying the IPv6 address.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same fixed caller arguments blocking the same IPv6 PTR result.

groups.operation: Have ares_parse_a_reply write the sixth IPv4 address and TTL pair.
groups.condition: A valid reply has six matching A records, while the caller supplies capacity for five.
groups.capability: Provide more than five address and TTL output slots to ares_parse_a_reply.
groups.consequence: The sixth IPv4 address and TTL pair cannot be written through this call.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity blocking the sixth A result.

groups.operation: Have ares_parse_aaaa_reply write the sixth IPv6 address and TTL pair.
groups.condition: A valid reply has six matching AAAA records, while the caller supplies capacity for five.
groups.capability: Provide more than five address and TTL output slots to ares_parse_aaaa_reply.
groups.consequence: The sixth IPv6 address and TTL pair cannot be written through this call.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the five-slot caller capacity blocking the sixth AAAA result.
